lines.beaver: 민지 씨, 행사 의상 좀 같이 봐 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, can you look at the event outfits with me?
lines.beaver_roman: minji ssi, haengsa uisang jom gachi bwa jullaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: I can't decide between this suit and the hanbok.
lines.learner: 저는 한복이 더 눈길을 끈다고 봐요.
lines.en: I think the hanbok catches the eye more.
lines.roman: jeoneun hanbogi deo nungireul kkeundago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Isn't a hanbok a bit uncomfortable?
lines.learner: 좀 불편해도 사진은 더 예쁘게 나와요.
lines.en: It may be a bit uncomfortable, but it looks nicer in photos.
lines.roman: jom bulpyeonhaedo sajineun deo yeppeuge nawayo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 한복으로 할까요? 색깔도 골라야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: Then shall we go with the hanbok? We need to pick a color too.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom hanbogeuro halkkayo? saekkkaldo gollaya haeyo.
lines.learner: 밝은 색이 행사에 잘 어울린다고 봐요.
lines.en: I think bright colors suit the event well.
lines.roman: balgeun saegi haengsae jal eoullindago bwayo.

lines.beaver: 아이 옷도 골라야 해요. 공연에 나오거든요.
lines.beaver_en: We need kids' clothes too. They're in the show.
lines.beaver_roman: ai otdo gollaya haeyo. gongyeone naogeodeunyo.
lines.learner: 아이들한테는 편한 옷을 입히는 게 좋다고 봐요.
lines.en: I think it's best to dress the kids in comfy clothes.
lines.roman: aideulhanteneun pyeonhan oseul ipineun ge jotago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: How about these pants? They have lots of pockets.
lines.learner: 호주머니가 있으면 손수건도 넣을 수 있겠어요.
lines.en: With pockets, they can carry a handkerchief.
lines.roman: hojumeoniga isseumyeon sonsugeondo neoeul su itgesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 행사를 밖에서 하니까 추울 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: The event is outside, so it might be cold.
lines.beaver_roman: haengsareul bakkeseo hanikka chuul sudo isseoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 따뜻한 겉옷도 준비해야 한다고 봐요.
lines.en: Then I think we should prepare warm jackets too.
lines.roman: geureom ttatteutan geodotdo junbihaeya handago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. When should we go to the costume shop?
lines.en: It'd be nice to go together at lunchtime.

lines.beaver: 다른 건 더 생각해 볼 거 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Is there anything else we should think about?
lines.beaver_roman: dareun geon deo saenggakae bol geo isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 의상은 행사 분위기에 맞아야 한다고 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, I think outfits should match the event mood.
lines.roman: ne, uisangeun haengsa bunwigie majaya handago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Thanks to you, it's easier to decide. Thanks.
lines.en: Not at all. The event will surely go well.
